worldcombat.skill.miracleeye.summary: Raise an inner eye through a foe's barrier: leave an insight mark that strips its current evasion and lights it up, so Psychic attacks are no longer immune to Dark; the same glance steadies your own aim, and the two ends expire on their own.
worldcombat.skill.miracleeye.use.0: break a Dark target's immunity before your Psychic hit
worldcombat.skill.miracleeye.use.2: raise your own accuracy before a Psychic strike
worldcombat.skill.miracleeye.description: Strip %1$s of the target's positive evasion (capped by what it has), and for %2$s make Dark no longer immune to Psychic moves, revealing it for %3$s.
The caster gains %1$s accuracy for %2$s; that is its own window on the caster, expiring separately from the target's mark.
worldcombat.skill.miracleeye.focus.on: Focus: %1$s wind-up and %2$s cooldown buy a longer window, reveal, self-focus and +1 insight.
worldcombat.skill.miracleeye.focus.off: Shallow read: shorter window, faster wind-up and cooldown, lower insight, good for breaking immunity often.
worldcombat.skill.miracleeye.description: Aim at an enemy entity: insight range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s; a blocked line of sight, an eye already open or a target already marked by Miracle Eye refuses the cast. Aiming at empty ground or an ally only opens your own eye and never hangs the mark on a non-enemy.
worldcombat.skill.miracleeye.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
Focus: target window x1.5, reveal x1.3, self-focus window x1.6, +1 insight, but +3 wind-up and +22 cooldown; off is shorter but faster, cheaper, with lower insight.
The companion only considers Miracle Eye within this distance of a threat; lower stays close, higher chases further.
When on, it will leave its post to open its inner eye.
worldcombat.skill.miracleeye.description: Each end expires on its own: when the target window runs out or the mark is removed, the stripped evasion is returned; when the caster's self-focus window ends, the borrowed accuracy is taken back. A new read returns the previous strip first, so the same evasion is never deducted and restored twice over.
